consistency_detail.CURRENT_BASELINES.md: CONSISTENT — Fully remediated by S726. §3 DL-008 phantom rows removed, replaced with RESOLVED entry citing S722A/S802/S726. §1 hashes recaptured. §2 pack counts corrected. §3 HIGH table updated with DL-016, DL-021 (corrected state), DL-026 (corrected scope).
consistency_detail.DEFECT_LIBRARY.md: PARTIALLY INCONSISTENT — DL-008 header Status (line 359) and Learner-Safety Status (line 445) remain stale since 2026-07-23, claiming 'Open — 175 remaining in Pack C'. The Affected table (lines 362-368) within the same entry correctly shows '539 identified — 539 resolved = 0 remaining' and 'Learner pool fully secured'. This is an internal contradiction: the body text is correct but the header and learner-safety section contradict it. The DL-029 entry (lines 2272-2326) is fully CORRECT — accurately documents the root cause of phantom counts.
consistency_detail.SESSION_STATUS_2026-07-24.md: INCONSISTENT — Wholly stale. 8 phantom/stale references found. Certified count (2,031) is 150 below ground truth (2,181). DL-008 count (67) is entirely phantom (0 actual). DL-016 severity understated (LOW/Cosmetic instead of HIGH). §8 recommends remediation of non-existent defects. Title claims 'Final Sweep' but document is 5 sessions behind ground truth (S802, S723, S725, S726 all postdate it).
consistency_detail.REVISION_HISTORY.md: CONSISTENT — All recent entries (S722A, S802, S723, S725, S803, S804, S537) accurately document 0 DL-008, 2,181 Certified, and the DL-029 root cause of phantom counts. S725 entry correctly catalogues 24 phantom references across 7 documents.
consistency_detail.governance-guard.js: CONSISTENT — Rule 2 BLOCK correctly enforces DL-008 prohibition. All 4 references to DL-008 are for the rule enforcement mechanism. NOTE: the findDL008Violations() function uses a ±1200-character window forward-scan that is DL-029-vulnerable per S725 Detection Standard. This does not make the references stale — the rule intent is correct — but the implementation methodology has a known scan reliability gap.

most_critical_stale: SESSION_STATUS_2026-07-24.md — the primary session handoff document reports 67 Certified DL-008 as CRITICAL (0 actual), undercounts Certified pool by 150 items, understates DL-016 as LOW/Cosmetic (should be HIGH), and recommends DL-008 remediation as the #1 next step (a non-existent task). Any agent following SESSION_STATUS alone would waste effort on phantom remediation and miss actual HIGH-severity defects (DL-016). CURRENT_BASELINES.md is now the authoritative document — SESSION_STATUS should be superseded.
